question: What is the smallest number of simultaneously read second-round public charge bits whose joint marginal distinguishes the fixed J8Y private-error pair with full-record TV 3/4 but zero one- and two-bit TV?
fork_classification: All six variable second-charge sites yield only 64 subsets. Exact marginal TV and parity-moment order are independent, reversible, in-scope diagnostics computable together from frozen complete laws with zero new Born work; no researcher ranking or scope expansion is needed.
frozen_model: R6AF ideal periodic L=2 D4 public instrument at p_X=1/10, p_Z=0. Freeze the J8Y unique higher-order cell: first-flux mask 3591, equal-prior private errors [0,5,16] and [2,4,15], identical full all-zero-charge first public record of likelihood one, relation-free five-edge public charge action [1,30,32,34,35], full action-conditioned second flux/charge/vacuum record. Private supports are analysis-only, not an action input.

hypotheses.third_order: At least one three-charge-bit joint marginal has positive exact TV; the minimum order is three after the preregistered one-/two-bit null.
hypotheses.higher_order: Every three-charge-bit marginal is equal and the first difference appears at order four, five or six.
hypotheses.censored: Any source, selection, fixed-outside-site, normalization, full-TV replay, data-processing, subset-count or CPU gate fails; no partial minimum-order inference is promoted.

matrix.cells: All 64 subsets of the six variable charge sites, grouped by order 0 through 6. For each exact pair of public laws, calculate joint-marginal TV and absolute difference of charge-parity expectation. Report first positive marginal and parity orders, max TV per order, first lexicographic maximizing site set and positive-subset counts. Verify all other 18 charge sites are fixed identically and the six-site TV equals complete public-record TV.
matrix.independent_unit: One exact charge-site subset under the frozen private-error pair and fixed public action; no sampling uncertainty.
matrix.integrity: Pin both complete-law census and J8Y selection result, replay private supports/first masses/action/full TV, check 64 exact marginal and parity contractions, one-/two-site zero, data processing, fixed outside-site charges, six-site equality, source hashes and zero Born/history/arm/bootstrap counters.

acceptance: All 64 prospectively fixed subsets and parity moments evaluated exactly
Minimum distinguishable joint marginal order and first parity order identified with full-law replay and data-processing gates
Conclusion restricted to the selected finite public-record cell; no full-IID information, logical risk, noisy JIT, scaling or threshold claim
stop_rule: Stop after the fixed six-site 64-subset matrix or first integrity/5-CPU-second cap. Do not select another witness, expand sites or model, evaluate new Born laws, generate histories or increase budget.
